AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))),
